fields.name: CATBO
fields.description: Current Access Type Back-off Timer: 0 = The back-off timer is applied in both 3GPP access type and non-3GPP access type; 1 = The back-off timer is applied in the current access type

fields.name: ABO
fields.description: All PLMNs Back-off timer: 0 = The back-off timer is applied in the registered PLMN; 1 = The back-off timer is applied in all PLMNs

notes: The 5GSM congestion re-attempt indicator is a type 4 information element with a length of 3 octets
Bits 3 to 8 of octet 3 are spare and shall be encoded as zero
